info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Internal Bank Account Management API
info.description: The Internal Bank Account Management API facilitates the seamless creation and configuration of internal bank accounts used for operational financial transactions. This API serves as a core component for financial institutions managing inter-account operations, enabling users to establish new accounts efficiently. Typical consumers include financial departments and banking software systems that require automated account setup to streamline operations. With this API, organizations can improve their financial processing capabilities and ensure robust management of their internal banking resources.

post.summary: Create a new internal bank account.
